It also points to how the poem builds this, through the grinding sounds of the octave and the "deep down" and "bent" imagery of the sestet.

It answers the simpler before-and-after reading in its opening, and reads the "ah!" as a speaker surprised into joy rather than reciting doctrine. The essay is consistently persuasive.

No factual errors found.
